errors.text: The proposed alloy and processing route do not reconstruct the target CoCrFeNiTi powder-metallurgy route involving high-energy ball milling and spark-plasma sintering.

The strongest system-specific evidence, E6, reports that adding 0.5 at.% C converts the C-free FCC+HCP structure into a single FCC phase, directly opposing the proposed carbon-stabilized FCC+HCP constitution.

E6 reports micrometer-scale grains rather than grains below 50 nm; no cited evidence supports obtaining or retaining a bulk sub-50-nm structure through 70% hot rolling and the proposed annealing treatment.
The claimed 4 at.% Mo solid-solubility and Mo4C precipitation boundary is not established by the supplied evidence with a quantified annealing temperature-time window.
The falsification rule treats precipitation in the 5 at.% Mo specimen as falsifying the hypothesis even though the stated hypothesis explicitly predicts instability above 4 at.% Mo.
The proposed experiment does not distinguish grain-boundary strengthening from simple solid-solution strengthening because it lacks grain-size-matched and composition-matched controls.
